purpose: Keep the main UI PCB and enclosure independent of the undocumented HMX035CTFT-001 flex details by moving the panel mate onto a small replaceable 40-to-40 adapter.

board.datum: top-left in the UI-inner placement frame

components.role: exact plug for the selected 2.0-mm stack
dual-contact ZIF for either exposed-contact orientation

electrical.mapping: PIN_n on the UI receptacle maps to PIN_n on the adapter plug and PIN_n on the panel ZIF for n=1..40
electrical.signal_contract: all display power, ground, QSPI, I2C, reset, backlight and strap contacts are preserved one-to-one

paper_checks.incremental_adapter_pcb_cost: factory RFQ required; no purchase authorized

evidence.finding: QDtech controls the donor assembly envelope and publishes the exact HMX035CTFT-001 electrical reference package.
FH34SRJ-40S-0.5SH(99) is an active 40-position 0.5-mm dual-contact ZIF with a controlled 22.0x3.8x1.0-mm body.
DF40C(2.0)-40DS-0.4V(58) controls the fixed 2.0-mm main-board receptacle stack.
DF40C-40DP-0.4V(51) is the exact 40-position mating plug.

release_boundary: H1 freezes the main-board bay, exact DF40 mate and one-to-one electrical map. H5 incoming inspection measures the current HMX035CTFT-001 tail outline, thickness, stiffener and bend path; a mismatch may revise only this adapter PCB and its panel-side connector, not the UI PCB or enclosure datum.
